subject: SEO Update — ARLO — 2026-08-13
html:
PageWhat ChangedTarget KeywordCheck It
/blog/agency-client-churn-warning-signs (new)New ~1,450-word post giving agency owners a concrete framework for catching client churn early — five leading-indicator signals (performance trend, engagement drop-off, value-questioning language, internal-champion turnover, data/access requests), what to do when one shows up, and an honest FAQ (including that "six weeks" is a rule of thumb, not a guarantee, and that ARLO doesn't predict churn — it just answers the one systematizable signal across a whole client book). Expands the real, already-live claim on /services/agency-owner rather than inventing a new one. BlogPosting schema auto-generated via the existing blog pipeline.Persona-anchored, not a keyword-volume play — checked live (agency client churn, reduce client churn agency, spot client churn early, etc. all show no measurable US search volume yet). Closes the single most-repeated open item on the content backlog: this exact post was flagged as still-missing in every worklog NEXT list since 2026-07-16 (7 sessions).askarlo.app/blog/agency-client-churn-warning-signs

Needs your attention (unchanged, now 9+ sessions): catalog.ts still marks Meta Ads/HubSpot/MailerLite coming_soon with their own stated ETAs past due (Meta Ads is 3+ months overdue, HubSpot's July ETA has now also passed) — this blocks any further connector-matrix pages until a product-owner call flips their status or confirms new ETAs.

Needs your attention (unchanged): off-page Phase 1 (Smithery.ai, Glama.ai, mcp.so, awesome-mcp-servers, AlternativeTo, SaaSHub) is still 0 of 6 — the single most overdue item on the whole plan, needs a human with a browser. Also unchanged: the dormant 6-persona route.ts scaffold (open since 2026-07-30) and GSC sitemap submission (open since kickoff, 2026-07-04).

Ranking context: spot-checked SE Ranking position data for the 22 tracked keywords — still 0 ranked (avg position 100) as of today, unchanged since the 2026-08-07 pulse. Not unexpected for a 6-week-old domain, but a full weekly-pulse-style session (backlinks, CI, catalog.ts, full rank report) is overdue and should run next.

Next: two blog angles remain queued — a GA4-specific 3-minute-setup how-to, and a dedicated "what happens to your clients' data when you connect an MCP tool" trust/security piece. Full detail in docs/seo-strategy/worklog.txt (top entry).
